lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 14 distinct high-contrast vertical line segments are visible on the torso. Spacing is variable, with wider intervals in the anterior section (approx. 50-60 pixels) and narrower, more compressed intervals in the posterior section (approx. 25-30 pixels).
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: Topological Y-shaped bifurcations are visible on the 5th stripe from the anterior edge (splitting near the dorsal ridge) and the 11th stripe (splitting near the ventral boundary).
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 2nd, 8th, and 12th stripes exhibit mid-mass terminations. The 13th stripe is fragmented into three vertically aligned discrete dashes.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of 6 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior haunch, situated between the final vertical stripe and the base of the tail.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two distinct spots on the mid-lateral thigh align to form a horizontal semi-connected geometric line segment.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a primarily linear trajectory with a slight medial (inward) curvature at the distal tips; the vector is oriented at approximately 55 degrees relative to the frontal-dorsal plane of the skull.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 1.75 times the pixel width of a single horn base.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 25% of the total visible vertical length of the horn structure.

other_distinctive_markers: White facial chevron, dual white spots on the lower cheek, and white transverse bands on the lower limbs above the hooves are clearly visible.
